runtime_binding.scope: Explicit command paths bound to the manifest binary hash verified at archive time. Five Nesso RISC-V cases use an independent executable; RMT checker analyzes a prior artifact. No runtime binaries copied.

layers.relationship: Original full run retained with Core2 IMU failure
Independent diagnostic only; never substitutes for the original full run

open_boundary.description: Original full Core2 IMU frame-marker checks fail/black although serial values are correct. Independent diagnostic PASS does not erase intermittent frame-marker behavior.

privacy.generic_tmp_paths: Retained synthetic repository fixture/runtime paths; no user-specific home prefix

artifact_policy.ppm_policy: All raw/packed PPM omitted; PNG retained and omitted size/hash recorded
artifact_policy.data_plane_artifacts: PCM/RMT virtual-controller artifacts; not physical recordings
